title: Stunning collection of prehistoric engravings found in Spanish cave | New Scientist
description: A close examination of a frequently visited cave wall in Spain has revealed a spectacular assembly of rock art engravings thought to be at least 19,000 years old
author: James Woodford

title: British Iron Age 'king' who prompted Roman invasion was probably a woman | New Scientist
description: Verica, a British ruler who encouraged the Roman emperor Claudius to launch an invasion, may not have been the man historians thought he was
author: Michael Marshall

title: Toothbrush that emits electricity may more effectively prevent gum disease | New Scientist
description: A toothbrush with bristles that produce electricity as they bend has shown promise for reducing plaque and gum inflammation
author: Christa Lesté-Lasserre

title: A dyslexia diagnosis can help struggling children, but what about the rest? | New Scientist
description: Children who struggle to read and are diagnosed with dyslexia can get additional help, but those who can't afford a test or don't meet the criteria get left behind. Surely there is a better way?
author: New Scientist

title: Nap schedules at childcare may not fit children's sleep needs | New Scientist
description: Most young children in countries like the UK, the US and Australia attend childcare, where their napping patterns often differ to when they are at home. But we don't know if this affects their development
author: Alice Klein

title: Physicists get first glimpse of the zeptoverse from LHC experiment | New Scientist
description: Data from the Large Hadron Collider has revealed evidence of a long-sought particle process that serves as a guide into the realm of the smallest scales ever probed
author: Karmela Padavic-Callaghan
